title: EntityAddress Schema
description: A reusable address schema used across the system for storing standardized address information.

addressLine1.description: Primary address line containing street number, street name, and apartment/suite if applicable

addressLine2.description: Secondary address line for additional address information (building name, floor, etc.)

city.description: Name of the city or municipality

country.description: Country name or code where the address is located

county.description: County or district name within the state/province

zip.description: Postal code or ZIP code for the address
